facts.text: The 400-acre J.G. Woodroof Farm features cultivated and grazing land for crops including cotton, soybeans, peanuts, and corn, along with commercial cow-calf beef herd forages, turfgrass research plots, a greenhouse, and nursery facilities.

sources.quote: J.G. Woodroof Farm. The 400-acre farm features cultivated and grazing land.

sources.title: sanr-beyond-classroom | Abraham Baldwin Agricultural College
sources.quote: The farm's major crops include cotton, soybeans, peanuts, and corn, along with various forages for our commercial cow-calf beef herd. It also includes turfgrass research plots, a greenhouse, and nursery facilities.

facts.text: The Georgia Museum of Agriculture features the only steam powered train in regular operation in Georgia.
